description: The shop's scheduling setup: time zone, booking hours (or the default when none are set), arrival window, travel buffer, reminder lead time, whether on the way notices go out, and whether arrival notices go out. Arrival notices are off unless the shop turns them on. When they are on, an on the way message includes an arrival time when one is known (a stored route estimate, or the time the worker entered; no drive time is looked up), and the customer gets a text and an email when the worker marks the visit arrived. On the way and arrived each go by text and by email. Any worker in the shop can read it.
name: schedule_settings

arrival_notices.description: When true, an on the way message includes an arrival time when one is known (a stored route estimate, or the time the worker entered), and the customer is told by text and email when the worker marks the visit arrived. Off by default. No drive time is looked up.

hours_source.description: default means the shop set no hours and Monday to Friday 08:00 to 17:00 is assumed.

time_zone.description: IANA zone all shop-local times use.

time_zone_set.description: False when the zone comes from the shop's jurisdiction.
